lines.text: A practice dummy, stuffed with old socks. It looks ready for anything.
The dummy wobbles at you. It's practice. Nothing here costs a minute.
You brush the grass off the dummy.
You stand it up straight. It looks proud.
The dummy stands tall. Good practice.
The dummy tips over and rolls behind the tree.
The dummy stands straight and proud.
